subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be integrated through the current `UserTurnTranscriptRecorder` queue path, or should OpenClaw add a separate public `AgentSession.steer` options object for `inputProvenance`?
rationale: Current main has changed the queued-turn API since this branch was authored, and choosing the wrong API direction can create duplicate provenance sources across session state, plugin SDK surface, and active wake delivery.

options.title: Rework onto recorder path
options.body: Rebase the PR and thread active-wake provenance through the current queue-recorder contract instead of adding a parallel steer options API.

options.title: Accept new steer options API
options.body: Keep the public `AgentSession.steer` options object and explicitly own the added plugin SDK surface, with compatibility tests for the recorder path.

options.title: Pause for wider subagent routing work
options.body: Hold this branch until the overlapping yielded-parent and subagent-completion routing cluster has one canonical API direction.

recommendation.title: Rework onto recorder path
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and thread active-wake provenance through the current queue-recorder contract instead of adding a parallel steer options API.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently touched the exact active parent wake and silent completion handoff code that this PR modifies.
